comments.body: I think it's better if we have the colormap defined once. Use fallback if the titiler isn't defined or fails to return proper value

code_window:

    72  function getColormapNames(injectableName) {
    73    if (window.mmgisglobal.WITH_TITILER === "true") {
    74      calls.api(
    75        "titiler_colormapNames",
    76        null,
    77        (res) => {
    78          // Use all colormaps from TiTiler directly (no filtering)
    79          let colormaps = res.colorMaps || [];
    80  
    81          // Sort alphabetically
    82          colormaps.sort();
    83  
    84          // ... new Set removes duplicates
    85          injectables[injectableName] = [
    86            ...new Set(
    87              injectablesDefaults[injectableName].concat(colormaps)
    88            ),
    89          ];
    90        },
    91        () => {
    92          console.warn(`Failed to query for ${injectableName}. Using defaults.`);
    93          // Fallback to common colormap names
    94          injectables[injectableName] = [
    95            "viridis", "viridis_r",
    96            "plasma", "plasma_r",
    97            "inferno", "inferno_r",
    98            "magma", "magma_r",
    99            "cividis", "cividis_r",
   100            "greys", "greys_r",

   111            "gist_earth", "gist_earth_r",
   112            "terrain", "terrain_r",
   113            "ocean", "ocean_r",
   114            "rainbow", "rainbow_r",
   115          ].sort();
   116        }
   117      );
   118    } else {

   143  }
